text:
alex: Quick sync — final readiness checklist for Marketplace GA (cloud listings + partner badges + joint blog). Need owners and any legal/compliance redlines by EOD.
kevin: I can run blog + press outreach. Draft authors: kevin, sara; reviewers: olga. Target send to press: Thu 09:00 PT with embargo lift Fri 10:00 PT.
sara: Solutions team will own partner demo playbook and three recorded walkthroughs (aws, gcp, on-prem). ETA: Wed EOD.
devin: Engineering will publish the marketplace integration repo and a short how-to. Need final API key rotation window from partners-bot so staging tokens expire before cutover.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: staging token expiry scheduled 2026-03-25T23:59Z unless updated. See /tokens.
olga: Legal review: short checklist — partner naming conventions, third-party logos, data residency claims on listing. I need the final landing copy and partner badge usage by Tue COB to sign off.
alex: Noted. Assigning owners: blog/press = kevin, demos = sara, listings + repo = devin, legal/q = olga. Who takes partner badge asset distribution?
kevin: Marketing owns badge assets and CDN hosting. Will publish a package to partners CDN by Wed 12:00 PT.
sara: For SI standby: propose on-call rota 08:00-16:00 PT with 2 engineers + 1 partner SME. Partner asks for a run-through Mon 11:00 PT.
devin: Can confirm infra side. Well set up a short incident dashboard (grafana link to be added) and a webhook for partner alerts.
marketplace-bot: Grafana dash created: https://dash.internal/g/marketplace-launch-1785. Ops alert policy: P1 -> pager, P2 -> email.
kevin: Press Qs — who is spokes? alex or olga? Prefer alex for product, olga for legal statements. Need a 1-pager per spokes by Wed.
olga: I will draft legal-safe boilerplate. Quick ask: avoid absolute uptime claims and remove the phrase "enterprise grade" unless we have certification.
alex: Good call. Marketing, please avoid that phrase in blog.
sara: Localization: we need translated microsite snippets for EN/FR/DE/JP by Thu EOD. Partners in APAC asked for EN/JP by Wed. Any volunteers?
kevin: I'll coordinate localization vendors. Will push translation keys to the content repo by Tue morning.
devin: Rollout plan: 1) Create listing drafts in AWS/GCP marketplaces 2) Staging approval 3) Flip listing live + telemetry smoke 4) Publish blog & press. Any objections?
olga: Confirmed. Add a legal checkpoint between steps 2 and 3.
alex: Agreed. Also need pricing SKU mapping table (hosted vs dedicated vs private) for the marketplace tile. kevin, can you add that to the blog appendix?
kevin: Yep — will include SKU map and short FAQ.
marketplace-bot: FYI: Partner badge asset package uploaded to /assets/partners/1785-badges.zip. CDN purge scheduled Wed 13:00 PT.
sara: Dry-run schedule: Mon 11:00 PT for SI playbook, Wed 14:00 PT staging smoke, Thu 09:30 PT pre-press health check. Invite posted.
devin: For cutover fallback: we keep old catalog route for 30 min after flip and have automated rollback if error rate > 3% or latency > 3x baseline. Ill add circuit-breaker config to runbook.
kevin: PR helpline: will staff 09:30-12:30 PT on go-live. Partnerships to field technical partner calls.
olga: Final deliverables list for legal: landing copy, blog draft, partner agreements summary, badge files. Send to me by Tue 17:00 PT.
alex: Action items recap: kevin -> blog + badge distribution; sara -> demos + SI rota + dry-run invites; devin -> repo + dash + rollback config; olga -> legal signoff checklist. If no blockers, we aim to open marketplace listings Fri 10:00 PT embargo lift. :rocket:
marketplace-bot: Calendar note created for embargo lift: 2026-03-27T10:00:00-07:00. Invitations sent to channel.
kevin: Thanks — Ill post a short comms doc to #marketing with press talking points once legal signs off.
sara: One more ask from partners: can we include a co-branded quickstart PDF in the asset package? Partners said that helps adoption.
kevin: Yes — will add co-branded quickstart. Please link any partner logos to the asset thread.
olga: Remember to include trademark approvals from partners. If logos change, we need updated approvals.
alex: Great. If anyone hits a blocker, mention @alex and Ill escalate to product ops. If everything is green by Tue COB, Ill mark this thread ready for go/no-go review.
kevin: Green for marketing once legal signs.
devin: Green for engineering after runbook patch and dash verification.
sara: Green for solutions after dry-run.
olga: Ill confirm legal sign-off by Tue 18:00 PT or earlier.
alex: Thanks all. Closing thread — keep updates concise here.
